entities.name: Temporal Crisis of Dominaria
entities.description: Multiverse-threatening phenomenon around 4500 AR in which time rifts siphoned mana and distorted reality on Dominaria.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Plane scarred by time rifts.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Detonated the Sylex Blast and experimented with time travel at Tolaria.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: War whose climax was the Sylex Blast.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event in which the artificial plane of Rath merged with Dominaria.

entities.name: Freyalise
entities.description: Planeswalker once revered as a goddess in Skyshroud who sacrificed her life to seal the Keld rift.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who phased Zhalfir and Shiv, later sealed the Shiv rift, sacrificing his spark.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: Helped Teferi restore Shiv to the timeline.

entities.name: Karona, False God
entities.description: Divine entity fused from Akroma, Phage (Jeska) and Zagorka whose death damaged the leylines.

entities.name: Akroma
entities.description: One of the three fused into Karona.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: Formerly Phage the Untouchable; closed the Zhalfir, Yavimaya and Otaria rifts.

entities.name: Zagorka
entities.description: One of the three fused into Karona.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: Panther warrior and protector of Urborg who gave his life to close the Urborg rift.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Silver golem planeswalker, Urza's heir, who sealed the Tolarian rift.

entities.name: Radha
entities.description: Whose soul and unknowingly inherited spark Jeska used to close rifts.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: Elemental avatar of Yavimaya, temporarily destroyed.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker who sacrificed Leshrac to seal the Madaran rift.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Rival planeswalker and shadow mage sacrificed by Bolas.

entities.name: Great Mending
entities.description: Metaphysical restructuring of the Multiverse that changed planeswalker sparks.

entities.name: Shiv
entities.description: Region whose rift Teferi sealed.

entities.name: Keld
entities.description: Region whose rift Freyalise sealed.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Region whose rift Windgrace closed.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: Site of Urza's temporal explosion and the Tolarian rift.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Region phased out and severed from the Multiverse.

entities.name: Yavimaya
entities.description: Region whose rift Jeska closed.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: Region whose rift Bolas sealed.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: Where Karona died and the final rift was sealed.

events.summary: The Sylex Blast, detonated by Urza in Argoth at the climax of the Brothers' War, creates the first known rift.
events.quote: detonated by Urza in Argoth, which created the first known rift

events.summary: Urza's time travel experiments cause a temporal explosion at Tolaria, forming the Tolarian rift.
events.quote: which fragmented time around the academy and formed the Tolarian rift

events.summary: During the Rathi Overlay, Freyalise overlays the Skyshroud Forest into Keld, opening another rift.
events.quote: Freyalise overlaid the Skyshroud Forest into Keld , opening yet another rift

events.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir and Shiv out of the timestream to protect them during the Phyrexian Invasion, tearing localized rifts.
events.quote: who removed large regions of the plane from the timestream to protect them

events.summary: Karona's death restores mana access but damages the leylines and destabilizes the rifts.
events.quote: Her death restored access but permanently damaged the planar leylines

events.summary: Mana drains into the rifts and Dominaria withers; nations decline and time anomalies spread.
events.quote: As mana drained into the rifts, Dominaria withered.

events.summary: Teferi, helped by Jhoira, restores Shiv to the timeline and seals the rift, sacrificing his spark and becoming mortal.
events.quote: sacrificing his spark and becoming mortal

events.summary: Freyalise sacrifices her life and destroys Skyshroud to seal the Keld rift.
events.quote: sacrificed her life and destroyed the forest she had once saved

events.summary: Lord Windgrace gives his life to close the rift above the Stronghold, lingering as a guardian spirit.
events.quote: gave his life to close the rift above the Stronghold

events.summary: Karn travels into the past to seal the Tolarian rift, then flees to Mirrodin unknowingly carrying Phyrexian oil.
events.quote: traveled into the past to seal the Tolarian rift

events.summary: Jeska uses part of Radha's soul to close the Zhalfir rift, severing Zhalfir from the Multiverse.
events.quote: severing Zhalfir from the Multiverse entirely

events.summary: Jeska burns out Radha's inherited spark, closing the Yavimaya rift but temporarily destroying Multani.
events.quote: burning out the spark Radha had unknowingly inherited

events.summary: Nicol Bolas sacrifices Leshrac to seal the Madaran rift.
Jeska seals the rift at the heart of Otaria, consuming her entirely and unleashing the Great Mending.
The Great Mending restructures the Multiverse; pre-Mending planeswalkers lose their powers, beginning the Mending Era.
